name: @dev-weiqi/sniffer
description: Self-hosted Flipper alternative: local daemon + web UI to monitor and mock an app's HTTP & Socket traffic.

scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node build/test/doctor.test.js && node build/test/adb.test.js && node build/test/api.test.js && node build/test/entryStore.test.js && node build/test/http.test.js && node build/test/mockStore.test.js && node build/test/png.test.js && node build/test/static.test.js && node build/test/testHandlers.test.js && node build/test/usbmux.test.js
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm --prefix ../ui run build && rm -rf ui-dist && cp -R ../ui/dist ui-dist
